title: Bankie Banx: King of the Dune
original_title: Bankie Banx: King of the Dune
overview: Bankie Banx: King of the Dune celebrates the life and genre-defying music of the Anguillian legend, Bankie Banx. Unfailingly true to himself, Bankie chased his dreams instead of industry success and wound up right where he was meant to be.
